summary: First-run end-to-end test of Parohia Sigmir trilingual site. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests passed (auth cookies, content CRUD, renovation, settings, contact, orthocal.info proxy for St Nicholas Dec 6). Frontend: Homepage hero, language switcher, announcements list/detail, Orthodox calendar page (external API integration), contact form, donate (IBAN + external), admin login, admin CRUD and settings save all worked.

minor.issue: allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is not spec-compliant; works currently because frontend is same-origin via ingress /api routing. If ever accessed cross-origin (e.g., production embed), browser will reject credentialed requests. Recommend setting CORS_ORIGINS to explicit frontend URL.

action_items: (Optional) Restrict CORS_ORIGINS to explicit frontend URL instead of '*' for future-proofing.
(Optional) Suppress the console 401 error from /api/auth/me on public pages (AuthContext could handle probe silently).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:275 CORS uses '*' with allow_credentials=True — non-spec-compliant; explicit origin recommended.
Auth uses SameSite=None; Secure=True cookies which is correct for cross-site. Currently same-origin via ingress works fine.
bcrypt hash used ($2b$), JWT httpOnly cookie, seed_admin correctly updates password if changed — all good.
server.py 401 responses returned but no brute-force / rate-limit / lockout is implemented (playbook expected 5-fail lockout). Not implemented — flagging as gap.
MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded via serialize() helper. Verified in responses (no _id leak).
server.py ~400 lines, single file — acceptable size, no refactor needed.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed() auto-created admin + settings + 8 content items + 2 renovation gallery items on startup. During tests, one TEST_PW_Anunț announcement was created via UI (not cleaned up automatically); consider manual deletion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows verified. Backend at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/api. Admin login sets httpOnly cookie access_token (SameSite=None,Secure). External orthocal.info proxy at /api/calendar/{y}/{m}/{d} works. No brute-force lockout implemented — if playbook requires it, main agent should add.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found in tested flows.
